features.title: Spatial

articles.title: The Stairwell
articles.blurb: SCP-087 is an unlit platform staircase.Stairs descend on a 38 degree angle for 13 steps before reaching a semicircular platform of approximately 3 meters in diameter.

articles.title: What Happened to Site-13?
articles.blurb: SCP-1730 was a large complex of structures 15km northwest of the US/Mexico border within Big Bend Ranch State Park that was discovered on June 5th, ████.

articles.title: O, Death
articles.blurb: SCP-2935 is a space-time anomaly existing within a limestone cave beneath a cemetery near Joppa, Indiana.

articles.title: The Red Pool
articles.blurb: SCP-354 is a pool of red liquid discovered in northern Canada.The liquid is of a consistency similar to that of human blood (hence the colloquial name Blood Pond) but is not of a biological nature.

articles.title: A Hole to Another Place
articles.blurb: Attempts to dig into SCP-1437 from the side result in the diggers encountering solid rock where logic would dictate SCP-1437 would be.

articles.title: The Architect
articles.blurb: Each face of the figure has a circular hole in the center, and a small sphere is attached to each vertex.

articles.title: The 12 Rusty Keys and the Door
articles.blurb: SCP-004 consists of an old wooden barn door (SCP-004-1) and a set of twelve rusted steel keys (SCP-004-2 through SCP-004-13).The door itself is the entrance to an abandoned factory in [DATA EXPUNGED].

articles.title: E is for Eternity
articles.blurb: SCP-7179 refers to an unknown number of cubic extradimensional spaces, measuring approximately 10 km on each edge.

articles.title: In the Court of Alagadda
articles.blurb: Attached to SCP-2264-A is a complex apparatus composed of alchemical tools such as alembics, retorts, and a crucible.

articles.title: Inscribable Object
articles.blurb: SCP-586 is a smelt metallic object, pale green in color.The anomalous profession of the object was discovered by accident.

articles.title: Inevitable
articles.blurb: BY ORDER OF OVERWATCH COMMAND This file has been cleared for access by all personnel.Readers are compelled to consume the following Sacrament.

articles.title: Sacrosanct
articles.blurb: SCP-5001 is a bio-mechanical structure approximately fifty-three kilometers in diameter, located a total of 60 kilometers under northern Russia.Immense depth and size.

articles.title: Bag of Holding Potatoes
articles.blurb: SCP-1689 is a burlap bag of potatoes.In its stable state, SCP-1689 weighs 40-50 kg and contains approximately two hundred (200) common agricultural potatoes (tubers of Solanum tuberosum).

articles.title: Skeleton Key
articles.blurb: In appearance, SCP-005 resembles an ornate key, displaying the characteristics of a typical mass produced key used in the 1920s.The key was discovered when a civilian used it to infiltrate a high security facility.
